gateway_model_name_rule.asserted_here: ASSERTED since 7.3.0. Every inferenceModels[].name MCC generates is run through accepts_regex / accepts_substrings / denylist_regex by tests/contracts/test_desktop_document_matches_app_rule.py. The 1.46 fixture recorded this filter and explicitly did not enforce it, because changing what MCC lists was a routing decision; 7.2.0 and 7.3.0 are that decision.
gateway_model_name_rule.evidence: function ES(e){let t=e.toLowerCase();return TS.test(t)?!1:CS.test(t)||wS.some((e=>t.includes(e)))} at offset 17443104, where CS=RegExp(`^(${SS.join("|")})(-[\d.]+)?$`), wS=["claude",...SS,"anthropic"] and TS is the foreign-vendor denylist above. MS(provider,name) dispatches 'gateway' and 'mantle' to it. FI(e,t,n) (offset 17692035) filters inferenceModels by MS and reports each rejection as `inferenceModels: "<name>" is not an Anthropic model and was removed from the list`, but only replaces the list when at least one entry survived (`a.length!==i.length&&a.length>0`), so a list in which every entry fails is passed through unchanged after every entry has been reported as an error.
